messages:
mike.carter: Ran a compliance sweep and found ~3.2k legacy DB snapshots uploaded without our current CMK tagging; some are SSE-S3 from pre-2023 agents.
jordan.lee: rough scope: single bucket or multiple?
mike.carter: two buckets across prod and staging. One has objects with kmsKeyId pointing to alias/old-org-cmk, the other has many with x-amz-server-side-encryption: AES256 and missing retention tags.
sarah.nelson: risk matrix: SSE-S3 -> not enforceable by our KMS policies; exposure if bucket policy leaked. Old-CMK objects -> need safe rewrap to new CMK.
leo: immediate containment?
mike.carter: block new legacy writes by adding IAM condition on uploader role requiring RequestTag:retention-level AND kms:EncryptionContext/tenant_id. That prevents future untagged uploads.
jordan.lee: detection: we currently miss object tag changes. Add CloudTrail rule for PutObjectTagging, PutObjectAcl, PutObject and CopyObject and forward to security-audit. Alert on any PutObject where SSE = AES256.
sarah.nelson: rewrap strategy: for SSE-KMS old-CMK objects use S3 CopyObject to same key with SSE-KMS:new-CMK and same metadata, capturing original ETag in audit bundle. For SSE-S3 objects, copy into quarantine bucket using SSE-KMS then back with proper tags.
leo: perms: rewrap job should not have broad kms:Decrypt. Use ephemeral grants scoped to the rewrap principal with kms:ViaService conditions or GrantTokens.
jordan.lee: tenant check: many objects include x-amz-meta-tenant; we must verify tenant->CMK mapping before rewrap to avoid key-crossing. Sarah, run a 1k sample and compare tenant metadata to registry. If mismatch > 0.5% escalate to legal.
sarah.nelson: will run sample now and produce counts. Also will add inventory script to flag objects with retention-level missing/none.
mike.carter: containment playbook draft: 1) enumerate public ACLs via get-object-acl/get-bucket-policy; 2) remove public ACLs and revoke pre-signed URLs; 3) apply temporary deny-bucket-policy except for service principals; 4) perform rewrap/copy with audit logging; 5) rotate any long-lived uploader creds used during remediation; 6) escalate to legal/customers if PII found.
jordan.lee: note infra: rewrapping 3k objects will spike KMS requests. Schedule batched windows and request a KMS quota bump if needed.
sre-bot: Reminder: IAM policy changes require on-call approval for deploys in the 02:00-04:00 UTC window.
leo: assignees: Sarah -> sample + CloudTrail PR; Jordan -> IAM condition PR + rewrap job perms; Mike -> coordinate and audit bundle spec; Leo -> containment scripts and runbook.
mike.carter: good. We'll hold customer notif until sample results. Sarah, ping here with sample output. Thanks all :thumbsup:
